proposed.explanation: Low displacement (10–15%) underestimates typical hybrid system performance; this would occur only with undersized PV arrays (<3 kW). Moderate savings (USD 1,500–2,500) corresponds to 20–30% displacement, insufficient for the stated 2:1 ratio and full tropical solar resource utilization. Displacement above 50% requires PV oversizing beyond 4:1 ratio or exceptional solar conditions; economically inefficient and not recommended for standard hybrid design. A 10 kW PV array with 5 kW diesel generator achieves 2:1 PV-to-generator ratio (within 2–4 kW PV per 1 kW diesel range). This configuration displaces 30–50% annual diesel consumption (~8,000–12,000 kWh/year from PV generation at 4.0 kWh/m²/day), saving USD 2,000–4,000/year at current diesel costs. System cost approximately USD 25,000–40,000 including battery and hybrid controller. Hybrid solar-diesel systems with 2–4 kW PV per 1 kW generator typically achieve 30–50% annual diesel displacement, generating USD 2,000–4,000 fuel savings annually and improving rural facility sustainability.
